items.name: sb.breakdown.llm_gemini
sb.composite.header
items.body: Create ONE single comic-style storyboard IMAGE with {n} numbered panels arranged in a {layout} grid (rows × cols). All panels MUST be drawn in the SAME image (not separate images).

items.name: sb.composite.negative_footer
items.body: Avoid: separate disconnected images, mismatched character designs between panels, missing panel numbers.

items.name: sb.composite.rules
items.body:
- Output ONE image divided into {n} panels in a {layout} grid
  - Each panel separated by a thin black border (~4px)
  - Number each panel in the top-left corner (1, 2, 3...)
  - All characters retain IDENTICAL design across every panel
  - Consistent style and color grading throughout
  - Overall aspect ratio: {aspect}
